# ANALYSIS: STAGE1_BASELINE_BACKTEST

**Filed:** 2026-07-21  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** analysis  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

We need to establish baseline edge_capture and wide_pnl for the current engine configuration using the Stage-1 autoresearch grinder before evaluating any strategy changes. This baseline will inform whether proposed candidates improve OP-16 edge_capture above the 771 floor.

## Mechanism

Run the autoresearch grinder's Stage-1 backtest over the full 16-month OPRA dataset (2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18) with the current engine parameters (as per automation/state/params.json). Compute:
- edge_capture = sum(engine_pnl_on_J_winners) - sum(max(0, engine_loss_on_J_losers))
- wide_pnl = total P&L across all days
Additionally record per-J-day P&L to compare against known anchor outcomes.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+; $1K paper ~= 14% headline  
2. **Sample bias:** Full 16-month OPRA dataset (n ≈ 345 trading days); selection is deterministic (all available data); overfit risk is low for baseline measurement but candidates derived from this sample will need OOS validation.  
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (Stage-1 is in-sample; OOS evaluation occurs in Stage-2)  
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (Stage-1 uses BS simulator; real-fills validation is a separate OP-20 gate)  
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day loss (if edge_capture < 0), max drawdown, blow-up scenario if edge_capture < 771; concentration risk if top-5 days exceed 100% of P&L.  
6. **Concentration:** unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest  

## Pre-merge gate

Gym validators must pass; walk-forward OOS Sharpe ≥ 0.70; real-fills validation on top-3 J days must show < ±20% divergence from BS sim; edge_capture ≥ 771 to avoid REJECTION.

## Confidence

3 / 10 -- No backtest results available yet; this analysis defines the required work. Confidence will increase upon receipt of Stage-1 output.
